title: Keldovan the Harrier
summary: Keldovan becomes easier to handle when the raid keeps killing his pit adds.
overview: Keep the pit-add kills flowing while a dedicated tank holds Keldovan. The recent-kill count weakens his defenses and abilities, but begins falling when kills stop.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Keep a separate tank on the pit adds.

roles.label: Damage dealers
tips: Continue killing adds instead of abandoning them once the boss is weakened.

phases.label: Build the advantage
phases.description: Kill the pit adds to accumulate the weakening effect.

phases.label: Maintain the advantage
phases.description: Continue add kills while damaging Keldovan; the recent-kill count decays after a gap.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Assign a group to the pit fiends and hounds while the main tank holds Keldovan.
Recent add kills weaken the boss, but that advantage decays if kills stop.
Keep healing and curse handling organized through his recurring combat spell rotation.
